I mean, NASA had the star kids.
tellings.difference: Calls the children 'star kids' and gives no place or date, where the story puts it in Florida in the late 1960s.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe a NASA program built around psychic children. The 'star kids' line matches the story about a NASA program with psychic kids.

as_told.title: NASA star kids remote viewing program

plain: In the late 1960s, the story goes, NASA, the US space agency, ran some kind of programme in Florida that worked with children thought to have psychic gifts. A researcher named Greg Malatzi says he has "heard a lot about" it, describing "somewhere in Florida" "a NASA thing with kids," though he passes it on second-hand. A guest named Jay Anderson, appearing as a witness, mentions it in a single line, "NASA had the star kids," and gives no place or date. If it were true, the space agency would have been quietly studying children for unusual mental abilities.
